episodes.synopsis: When the shape-shifting alien Blasters invade Earth to steal its oxygen, humanity's only chance is Ganger, a robot of living metal merged with a half-human/half-alien boy.
episodes.title: Let's Go, Ganger

episodes.synopsis: Kantaro learns more about the legacy his alien mother left him, while the Blasters plan on using a freeze ray to immobilize their new enemy, Ganger.
episodes.title: The Living Robot

episodes.synopsis: The Blasters cause a volcano to erupt so they can take over a populated island for their latest plot.
episodes.title: The Burning Island Plot

episodes.synopsis: The Blasters use a giant moving rainbow that drains all nature of its vitality.
episodes.title: Rainbow of Terror

episodes.synopsis: In an attempt to learn Ganger's secret, the Blasters send one of their own to Earth, in the form of Maya, Kantaro's mother.
episodes.title: Search for Ganger's Plot

episodes.synopsis: The Ganger's latest secret weapon has Ganger trapped and suddenly rusting out inside an underground cavern.
episodes.title: Rusty Ganger

episodes.synopsis: While Ganger is on a deep space mission, the Blasters redirect a rocket with a nuclear warhead towards ISP Branch 4 on Earth.
episodes.title: Space Bomber

episodes.synopsis: The Blasters send voracious, ball-like Space Hounds to Earth to devour Ganger.
episodes.title: Space Hounds

episodes.synopsis: An old woman in sad circumstances has the trust of Rie and her family. Too bad she's a Blaster in disguise.
episodes.title: Suspicious Granny

episodes.synopsis: The Blasters brainwash Rie's young cousin and put him in a fake Ganger robot to battle the real thing.
episodes.title: I'm Strong! Ganger

episodes.synopsis: The Blasters toy with the idea of annihilating all life on Earth and then starting over, but will proceed only if a certain experiment is successful.
episodes.title: Earth is Ours!

episodes.synopsis: While camping, Kantaro and Rie discover an experimental Blaster teleportation device that's guarded by a psychotic old man.
episodes.title: The Valley of Shooting Stars

episodes.synopsis: A giant Blaster robot threatens to destroy major cities until Ganger shows up for a showdown, but Kantaro is in the hospital, unconscious with a high fever.
episodes.title: Showdown in the White Wilderness!!

episodes.synopsis: Late at night, snowmen come to life and attack the town courtesy of Bad Snow, an alien villain in league with the Blasters.
episodes.title: Showdown Under the Midnight Sun

episodes.synopsis: A sunspot monster in the form of a fairy causes a mysterious aurora that drains the city of its power.
episodes.title: Secret of the Aurora

episodes.synopsis: The Blasters threaten Earth with a formal declaration of war and assured destruction from a powerful alien ally unless humans surrender and turn over Ganger.
episodes.title: Blaster Declaration of War

episodes.synopsis: The Blasters brainwash an employee of ISP (and friend of Kantaro) and use him to find Ganger's secret or blow up the buildings if he can't.
episodes.title: The Horrible Spy Monster

episodes.synopsis: When Kantaro gets a space disease, Ganger has to rush him to his mother's home planet for a cure, but the Blasters intercept them with a death trap.
episodes.title: Chain Mail Whirlpool

episodes.synopsis: Rie escapes Blaster captivity, but can she warn Ganger in time that the giant robot he's battling will explode with an antimatter bomb in a matter of moments?
episodes.title: Time Bomb Robot Monster

episodes.synopsis: A robot steps out of a popular manga magazine every time the page is opened and abducts the child reader, including Rie and Kantaro.
episodes.title: The Lensmer Avatar Plot

episodes.synopsis: Ganger investigates when children go missing inside a robot theater on the outskirts of town.
episodes.title: The Robot Force Has Come!

episodes.synopsis: The Blasters and Ganger vie for possession of a space ghost ship with a secret weapon.
episodes.title: Space Ghost Ship

episodes.synopsis: After a disastrous duel, Ganger and Kantaro are stranded on Kantaro's mother's dead home planet.
episodes.title: Duel on Kantaros

episodes.synopsis: Kantaro feels the pain as Ganger is tortured millions of miles away.
episodes.title: Aim For His Chest Pendant!

episodes.synopsis: Blaster Devil employs mind control powers and Rie's abduction in an attempt to make Ganger surrender.
episodes.title: The Devil's Eye

episodes.synopsis: Must Ganger make the ultimate sacrifice to save Earth once and for all from the Blasters?
episodes.title: Space Panther
